title: Gitea · Recent repositories
description: Recently updated repositories from a Gitea API. Uses Gitea directly; no helper required. Public repositories can work anonymously. Configure private read-only credentials separately if needed. Setup: see this package's INSTALL.md in the public source release. Add an approved public source URL before submitting. Configure actual service URLs and credentials locally after import; never upload them to Workshop.
changelog: Initial public release; portable example URLs and documented local setup.
